// Local shape classification of a surface point by its principal
// curvatures: Gaussian curvature positive (Elliptic), exactly one zero
// principal curvature (Parabolic), Gaussian negative (Hyperbolic), both
// zero (Planar), or equal and nonzero (Umbilic).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Differential_geometry_of_surfaces)
type SurfacePointShape = Elliptic | Parabolic | Hyperbolic | Planar | Umbilic;
